dict.string: Eavesy records your microphone so it can transcribe your meetings and dictation.
Eavesy captures system audio from your meetings so it can transcribe everyone on the call.
Eavesy shows live captions and pastes dictation using speech recognition on this Mac.
Eavesy watches for new screenshots here when you turn on "Add macOS screenshots automatically", and reads files you drop into it.
Eavesy reads files you drop or paste into it from your Downloads folder.
Eavesy reads files you drop or paste into it, and watches for screenshots if macOS saves them here.
Eavesy pastes your transcript into the app you're using.
